title: Validate before commit
purpose: Run the smallest owning checks first, then foundation checks, diff hygiene, and evidence readback.
steps: Run the operational harness completeness validator when operational harness files changed.
Run each domain-owning validator selected from validator-registry.json for the changed surface.
Run git diff --check against the intended base.
Run foundation validators that cover touched shared contracts.
Confirm generated evidence and machine-local output are untracked.
Review staged diff and verify only owned paths are included.
Record command, exit code, and proof ceiling in the validation ledger.
failureBehavior: Stop commit. Route to failure-recovery with the exact failing command and output summary.
outputs: commit gate pass or explicit blocker
proofCeiling: Static/offline correctness for the validated surfaces; not live runtime or deployment.
